description: On-demand drill-down for HTTP, PostgreSQL, cache, workers, and container resources. Rows are collapsed to avoid background query load.

panels.description: Completed API requests per second grouped by HTTP status code.
panels.title: HTTP status distribution

panels.description: Database operation rate by operation and outcome.
panels.title: Database operation outcomes

panels.description: p95 and p99 latency per database operation; selected operations are kept separate.
panels.title: Database operation latency

panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second for the Retsu database.
panels.title: Transaction rate

panels.description: PostgreSQL 18 pg_stat_io bytes read and written per second across retained backend types and contexts.
panels.title: I/O throughput

panels.description: Seconds spent in PostgreSQL read and write operations per wall-clock second from pg_stat_io.
panels.title: I/O time

panels.description: Write-ahead log bytes generated per second.
panels.title: WAL generation

panels.description: Total table footprint, including indexes and TOAST, for queue tables.
panels.title: Queue table sizes

panels.description: Estimated live and dead tuples in queue tables. Dead tuples indicate vacuum pressure.
panels.title: Queue table tuples

panels.description: Current top pg_stat_statements query hashes joined into one table. N/A is expected if the optional statement metrics are unavailable.
panels.title: Ranked SQL statements

panels.description: PostgreSQL buffer-hit percentage while the database is active. N/A is honest when the exporter or workload is absent.
panels.title: Buffer hit ratio

panels.description: Cache lookups and fallback outcomes per second; all series use operations per second.
panels.title: Cache request outcomes

panels.description: Hit percentage by logical cache; N/A means the cache was not exercised.
panels.title: Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Cache population p95/p99 per logical cache; fallback rates are kept in the outcomes panel.
panels.title: Cache load latency

panels.description: 95th-percentile duration of successful and failed state collection attempts.
panels.title: State collection latency

panels.description: Expired messages and successful cleaner database operations per second.
panels.title: Expired-message cleaner activity

panels.description: Container working-set memory compared with configured memory limits.
panels.title: Memory working set and limit

panels.description: Filesystem bytes read and written per second by selected Retsu runtime containers. Filesystem capacity is intentionally not shown because OrbStack does not expose reliable capacity series.
panels.title: Filesystem throughput

panels.description: Network receive and transmit throughput summed across container interfaces.
panels.title: Network throughput

panels.description: Seconds since cAdvisor last observed each selected container.
panels.title: Container scrape freshness

panels.description: PgBouncer transaction-pool throughput, latency, wait pressure, connection states, and configured route capacity.
PgBouncer pooled transactions and queries per second for the Retsu route. N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: Transaction and query rate

panels.description: Mean query execution time derived from cumulative query duration and query count. N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: Average query time

panels.description: Mean server-assigned transaction time in PgBouncer transaction mode. N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: Average transaction time

panels.description: Mean client wait time per pooled transaction. Sustained non-zero wait indicates pressure; N/A means the exporter is absent.
panels.title: Average client wait

panels.description: Client and backend connection counts per database/user pool. Waiting clients turn warning-colored above zero.
panels.title: Pool connection states

panels.description: Configured regular/reserve pool sizes and current/maximum route connections for name=retsu. All values are connection counts.
panels.title: Configured route capacity
